a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs about 3 storm-free rounds, so we'd both likely die. I'm openly breaking the agreement and taking 4 in round 1. Please don't also take, because a random split would likely leave us both short. After that I'll operate every round with you, and you take everything the generator makes until you have 4. I won't take anything beyond my 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round because the storm odds make the original plan nearly fatal for both of us.
